proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10555 *rakṣāpuṭaka explicitly supplies Gujarati rākhɔṛo/rākhɔṛī ashes or layers of ashes. The western Bhil rukhəḍ/rakhuḍ/rokhoḍ ash series matches that extended ash family, with r/ḍ notation, initial-vowel variation, deaspiration and endings qualified. It is kept distinct from plain rakṣā 10552 and nasal *rakṣākuṇḍaka 10553 ash-pit. No source spelling is corrected; local transmission is unresolved. Exact response: rukhudu.
